# Animation libraries

GSAP and ScrollTrigger 3.13.0, unmodified distribution files from the
`gsap` npm package, downloaded via jsDelivr. Served locally by the application.
Upstream copyright and license notices are retained in each file.

- https://gsap.com/docs/v3/
- https://gsap.com/community/standard-license/
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/gsap.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js
